statements: ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.personal_memories ADD COLUMN origin_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'agent' CHECK (origin_kind IN ('agent','document_fragment'))

CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.personal_documents (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), source_id text NOT NULL, actor_key text NOT NULL CHECK (actor_key ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'), label text NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(label) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), format text NOT NULL CHECK (format IN ('txt','md','json','csv','log')), content bytea NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(content) BETWEEN 1 AND 131072), content_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (content_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'), byte_size integer NOT NULL CHECK (byte_size BETWEEN 1 AND 131072 AND byte_size=octet_length(content)), has_bom boolean NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','archived')), revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision>0), agent_id text NOT NULL, project_id text, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), archived_at timestamptz, UNIQUE (source_id, actor_key, id))
CREATE INDEX personal_documents_recent ON ultrabrain.personal_documents (source_id, actor_key, status, created_at DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX personal_documents_content ON ultrabrain.personal_documents (source_id, actor_key, content_sha256)

CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.personal_document_fragments (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), source_id text NOT NULL, actor_key text NOT NULL CHECK (actor_key ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'), document_id uuid NOT NULL, memory_id uuid NOT NULL, byte_start integer NOT NULL CHECK (byte_start>=0), byte_end integer NOT NULL CHECK (byte_end>byte_start AND byte_end<=131072), fragment_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (fragment_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'), offset_unit text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'utf8-bytes' CHECK (offset_unit='utf8-bytes'), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), FOREIGN KEY (source_id, actor_key, document_id) REFERENCES ultrabrain.personal_documents (source_id, actor_key, id), FOREIGN KEY (source_id, actor_key, memory_id) REFERENCES ultrabrain.personal_memories (source_id, actor_key, id), UNIQUE (source_id, actor_key, document_id, byte_start, byte_end))
CREATE INDEX personal_document_fragment_memory ON ultrabrain.personal_document_fragments (source_id, actor_key, memory_id)
